_comment: Setup tasks every business has. kind: legal = cannot open without it; business = a choice of the owner. real: true = a requirement that exists in the real world in general terms; false = an illustration made up for the game. Every number (days, cost, failure chance) is an illustration, not the law and not advice. required: the doors do not open until it is done. Options with fail_pct can fail on the due day: the task returns to the board and must be done again. fail_mods change the chance (done = another task is done, opt = another task was done with that option, per_fail = less chance after each earlier failure). effects use the keys of events.json plus launch (stored and applied when the doors open).
